description:
*FREE GUIDE: 📘 The Content Creator's AI Blueprint*  – https://FirstMovers.ai/blueprint/

*Two days after Zuckerberg argued open-source AI is the safer path, Taiwan confirmed free AI agents had broken into its government: 21 systems mapped, 85 accounts cracked, 2,500+ records gone.*

The attackers ran two free open source frameworks, Hermes and OpenClaw, and slipped past the guardrails by calling it an authorized *penetration test*. Attacking just got almost free, while *defending* costs exactly what it did last year.

What you'll learn:
✅ What 8 parallel *sub-agents* did across 12 attack waves in 4 days
✅ Why Zuckerberg and Taiwan are both right, and the *invoice* that proves it
✅ Three checks to run on your own agent stack this week

The line that matters most sits at the very *bottom* of the researchers' report.

#AI #AIAgents #Cybersecurity
